post.description: Search public jobs across all YC companies. Title words (e.g. intern summer 2027, founding engineer) are matched against the job title in every job URL of YC's public jobs sitemap (never the company slug), newest first; role, type, remote_allowed / remote_only, country and location filters are applied while job pages are read, so a call keeps scanning until page_size records (default 10, max 50) are found or the per-call cap of 120 job pages / 30 s is reached (scan_limited true, partial page plus next_offset). Returns excluded counts per filter and candidates_scanned. A pasted /jobs/role/<role>[/<location>] or /jobs/location/<location> URL supplies role and location.

country.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 code from the derived countries. Pattern: ^[A-Z]{2}$.

location.description: Case-insensitive text in the source location (e.g. new york), or a country name matched against derived countries.

offset.description:
Candidate offset; pass next_offset from the previous call. The scan resumes right after the last candidate the previous call read, so nothing is skipped or repeated.

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 10000; default 0.

page_size.description:
Records per call. Default 10 for title / sitemap scans and 50 (the whole page) for listing pages.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 50.

query.description: Title words; each must appear in the job title slug of the job URL (plural and -ship forms count, so intern matches internship). Company names and slugs are not matched; use the jobs function for one company. Omit to scan all jobs newest first.

remote.description:
Legacy exact match on the derived remote mode: remote is the same as remote_only true (fully remote roles, including country-restricted ones such as Remote (US)); hybrid and onsite match only that mode. Prefer remote_allowed or remote_only.

Provider reference: allowed values ["remote", "hybrid", "onsite"].

remote_allowed.description: true keeps roles that accept remote work (derived remote or hybrid, i.e. remote is an option); false keeps on-site-only roles. Roles whose location does not parse are excluded either way.

remote_only.description: true keeps fully remote roles only (derived remote, including country- or region-restricted remote such as Remote (US) or Remote - Canada); false keeps hybrid and on-site roles.

role.description:
Source role code.

Provider reference: allowed values ["eng", "design", "product", "science", "sales", "marketing", "support", "operations", "recruiting", "finance", "legal"].

type.description:
Source job type. Some internships are typed Full-time at the source; query intern catches those by title.

Provider reference: allowed values ["Full-time", "Part-time", "Internship", "Contract"].

post.description: Browse or search the public YC company directory. Query is optional: omit it to list every company matching the exact source labels for batch (e.g. Summer 2025), industry, region, status and tag, or the hiring, top company and nonprofit flags. A pasted directory URL (/companies?batch=Winter%202025&industry=B2B) or industry page URL (/companies/industry/robotics) supplies the same filters. Twenty entries per zero-based page, at most fifty pages.

batch.description: Exact batch label as published by YC, e.g. Summer 2025 or Winter 2022. Use the batches function to list valid labels.

hiring.description: Only companies the directory flags as hiring (true) or not hiring (false).

industry.description: Exact industry label, e.g. B2B, Consumer, Healthcare, Fintech.

page.description:
Zero-based page; next_page in the output gives the following page or null when exhausted.

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 49; default 0.

query.description:
Free-text search over company names and descriptions. Omit or leave empty to browse by filters only.

Provider reference: default "".

region.description: Exact region label, e.g. America / Canada, United States of America, Europe, Remote.

status.description:
Source-reported company status.

Provider reference: allowed values ["Active", "Acquired", "Public", "Inactive"].

tag.description: Exact tag label, e.g. Developer Tools, AI, Open Source.

top_company.description: Only companies on the YC Top Companies list.

url.description: A pasted https://www.ycombinator.com/companies URL (its query, batch, industry, regions, tags, status, isHiring, top_company and nonprofit parameters; short batch codes like W25 are expanded) or /companies/industry/<slug> (matched to the directory's industry label, else its tag label). Explicit inputs take precedence over URL values.
